stemMarkdown: Two cars start at the same time from two points 83 km apart and travel towards each other at 50 km/h and 59 km/h respectively. After how many hours will they meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Relative speed (approaching) $= 50 + 59 = 109$ km/h. Time to meet $= \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{relative speed}} = \dfrac{83}{109} = 0.76$ hours.
